title: Squirrel with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- Tail behind body -->
    <path d='M68 62 C88 58 92 34 78 26 C66 19 58 30 62 40 C64 46 62 52 58 58 Z' fill='#E08A2E' stroke='#F7C570' stroke-width='2' />
    <path d='M72 48 C80 44 82 34 76 30' fill='none' stroke='#F7C570' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' />
    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx='48' cy='66' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#D97A22' stroke='#F5B95E' stroke-width='2' />
    <!-- Belly -->
    <ellipse cx='46' cy='72' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#FBE3B8' />
    <!-- Back leg -->
    <ellipse cx='56' cy='86' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#B85F16' />
    <!-- Front leg / paw -->
    <ellipse cx='42' cy='84' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#C96B1B' stroke='#F5B95E' stroke-width='1.5' />
    <!-- Little front paws near chest -->
    <ellipse cx='52' cy='70' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#EB9A45' />
    <!-- Head -->
    <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='18' fill='#E08A2E' stroke='#F7C570' stroke-width='2' />
    <!-- Cheek -->
    <circle cx='30' cy='44' r='8' fill='#FBE3B8' />
    <!-- Ears -->
    <ellipse cx='28' cy='21' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#D97A22' stroke='#F7C570' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(-15 28 21)' />
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#D97A22' stroke='#F7C570' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(12 50 20)' />
    <!-- Eyes -->
    <circle cx='34' cy='36' r='5' fill='#3B1E5E' />
    <circle cx='47' cy='35' r='5' fill='#3B1E5E' />
    <!-- Sparkly highlights -->
    <circle cx='35.5' cy='34' r='2' fill='#FFF8E0' />
    <circle cx='48.5' cy='33' r='2' fill='#FFF8E0' />
    <circle cx='33' cy='37.5' r='1' fill='#B48CFF' />
    <circle cx='46' cy='36.5' r='1' fill='#B48CFF' />
    <!-- Nose -->
    <circle cx='26' cy='43' r='2.5' fill='#7A3B10' />
    <!-- Mouth -->
    <path d='M28 47 Q31 50 34 47' fill='none' stroke='#8A4413' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' />
    <!-- Whisker dots -->
    <circle cx='22' cy='46' r='0.8' fill='#8A4413' />
    <circle cx='22' cy='50' r='0.8' fill='#8A4413' />
    <!-- Acorn in paw -->
    <ellipse cx='36' cy='78' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#C8892F' />
    <path d='M31 75 Q36 71 41 75' fill='#7A5220' />
  </g>
</svg>
